turn: I added a parse cache in `src/cache/parse-store.ts`. It exports `CACHE_DIR` (`.migralint/cache`) and a `storeAst(key, ast)` function. The function creates the `ast` subdirectory if it's missing and writes the serialized AST to `.migralint/cache/ast/<key>.json`. I haven't run anything. I didn't run the tests, the type checker or a manual write, so the code is unverified. The module only writes. Nothing reads cached ASTs back yet, so the parser doesn't use the cache. While in the same commit I also made one small unplanned fix. It's unrelated to the cache, and I've listed it separately. Next I'll start on "Cache for rule results".
